briefdescription.para: Unit tests for ContentManager::ingestStream() – chunked ingestion for large files (Issue #1695 / roadmap Phase 3).

detaileddescription.para:
These tests exercise:
Streaming-capable MIME types (text/plain, text/csv, NDJSON) processed without buffering the full content.
Non-streaming MIME types buffered up to max_buffered_bytes.
Back-pressure: rejection when non-streaming content exceeds the limit.
Small-file fast path (stream exhausted in header read).
Empty stream handling.
ContentChunker: overlap parameter validation (ensures overlap < chunk_size).
ContentChunker: exact-size boundary (data.size() == chunk_size).
ContentValidator integration: MIME type and format validation in the streaming security gate (content_validator.cpp requirement).
